AttributeList.Text: Called by the CPU when a PROFINET IO device drops off the network, and again when it comes back. Writes station health into Diag_DB. Two reasons this block exists. The first is that nothing else notices: before it, an ET200SP could lose power and the valves on it would simply stop answering while the HMI carried on showing their last known positions as live. The second is that on some SIMATIC CPUs an unhandled station-failure event puts the whole CPU into STOP - one station taking the entire system down. Whether the 1214C does that is not documented in what was checked, so the block is present on the safe side regardless.
